## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Note any changes to prompts, source data, scoring, or provider request shapes.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm run data:prepare`
- [ ] `npm run bench -- run --dry-run`
- [ ] No credentials, raw run artifacts, or local editor/agent state included
- [ ] Methodology and provenance updated if benchmark behavior changed

Live API calls are optional and must be identified separately from offline tests.
